user.title: CARTelemetry
user.description:
Enter the car name exactly as it is set in the Car2Hass Android app (Settings → Car name). The app signs every data payload with this name, so it must match letter for letter.

Third-party apps can also push telemetry via the open API contract — see the developer guide: https://mytechnic.ru/cartelemetry/manual/integration/third-party/

data_description.car_name: Letters, digits, underscore and dash only (no spaces), up to 64 characters

error.invalid_car_name: Use only letters, digits, underscore and dash (no spaces)

abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this name is already configured

init.title: CARTelemetry options
init.description: Rename the vehicle and tune how much telemetry history is written. Changing any option reloads the integration; do not forget to update the car name in the Android app too.

data_description.history_replay: On: record every value from an offline batch (full history, higher load). Off: record only the latest value per signal (lower load, gaps in history).
data_description.replay_rate: Upper bound of telemetry state writes per second for this car (50-5000). Lower values are gentler on Home Assistant and its database.
data_description.adaptive_backlog: When on, batches larger than the threshold use the backlog replay mode instead of replaying every point.
data_description.backlog_threshold: Batches with more snapshots than this are treated as an offline backlog (1-1000).
data_description.backlog_replay: Throttled: keep full history, rate-limited (default). Latest: keep only the latest value per signal (lightest on the database, less history detail).

error.invalid_car_name: Use only letters, digits, underscore and dash (no spaces)
